about.heading: About Me
paragraphs: I am an Infrastructure AIOps Engineer at TVS Supply Chain Solutions. I started there in L1 technical support, troubleshooting endpoints, access and connectivity, and moved into cloud and infrastructure operations.

Today I support AWS and Linux environments, work with Terraform and Azure DevOps, and develop Python and Bash tools for health checks, incident analysis and reporting. Operational changes still go through human review. Outside work, I build a self-hosted lab with Proxmox, Samba NAS, Tailscale, Jenkins and n8n.

cloudOps.heading: Featured CloudOps Work
cloudOps.title: Enterprise CloudOps Automation Platform
cloudOps.intro: This is an internal team project. As an Infrastructure AIOps Engineer, my contribution is to develop discovery, health checks and workflow integration, and to design incident analysis that keeps engineers in control of remediation. The items below describe work in progress, not a completed deployment.
cloudOps.role: My role: Infrastructure AIOps Engineer · Contribution: development and operational design

work.title: Resource discovery
work.problem: Infrastructure is spread across multiple AWS accounts, Azure and Nutanix, so operators need a consistent view for discovery and reporting.
work.solution: I am developing resource discovery and operational reporting across those environments.

work.title: Linux health checks
work.problem: Recurring health checks and operational reports take time when they are handled manually.
work.solution: I am building Python API services and Bash checks, with runbooks to make routine analysis more repeatable.

work.title: Workflow orchestration
work.problem: Operational tasks span APIs, Docker workloads and multiple automation tools.
work.solution: I am connecting Python services and Docker workloads with n8n, Celery and Temporal for coordinated workflows.

work.title: Incident analysis
work.problem: An incident needs useful context before an engineer decides whether to change a system.
work.solution: I am designing AWS Bedrock-assisted analysis that presents findings for human review before remediation.

personalProjects.title: Self-Hosted Infrastructure Lab
personalProjects.problem: I wanted a private environment for practising server operations, remote access, CI/CD and automation without exposing lab services publicly.
personalProjects.solution: I built a Proxmox home server and Samba NAS, connected lab devices with Tailscale, and self-hosted Jenkins and n8n for practice.

items.title: AWS Infrastructure with Terraform
items.problem: A multi-AZ AWS environment needs repeatable network, compute, database, storage and access definitions.
items.contribution: I authored reusable Terraform modules for VPC, EKS, RDS, S3, ALB and IAM. The repository defines public, private and database subnets, EKS managed node groups and S3 protection settings.

items.title: Server Management System
items.problem: Server inventory, access and audit information need a central place for administrators.
items.contribution: I maintain the project repository. Its code covers server inventory, SSH key management, role-based permissions and audit logging through a web interface and API.

items.title: AI Orchestrator System
items.problem: A self-hosted AI assistant needs a way to coordinate services, route requests and observe health.
items.contribution: I maintain a repository with service-management scripts, model routing, monitoring and configuration for an OpenClaw-based lab system.
